name: LOVE NOTE PLUS
source:
Write a person's name in the LOVE NOTE and they will want to breed with you.
It's the mystical notebook of a shinigami, and it's in your hands.
Nobody can stop you now, not the police, not even gods.
And sex is not the end. Only the beginning.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ055674.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
只要在“恋爱笔记”上写下某个人的名字，对方就会渴望与你交合繁衍。
这是属于死神的神秘笔记本，如今已落入你的手中。
再也没有任何人能阻止你——无论是警察，还是神明。
而性爱并非终点，仅仅只是开始。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ055674.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
